about: Caps on the whole series (tools/check.py check 10 stack). A crossing means: refactor (one extension point plus rows) or get an Owner-approved raise. A raise appends {from, to, measured, why, date, approved: 'Owner-approved YYYY-MM-DD'} to the metric's raised list, to = the value measured after review cuts, and sets cap to it. Lowering a cap: re-derive set.
margin_rule: cap = measured + ceil(measured / series mods): room for one more average mod, from set {measured, mods}. In a folder with modules the metrics are measured on the module patches and mods counts the feature rows
